-- 当前 24h 的契约指标，外加前 14 天(不含当天)的滚动中位数基线
WITH ok AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day,
           count(*) AS total,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE char_length(summary) > 200) AS too_long
    FROM public.tech_news
    WHERE summary IS NOT NULL
      AND summary <> 'Analysis failed due to content access issues.'
      AND created_at >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '15 days'
      AND created_at <  (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 day'
    GROUP BY 1
),
bad AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, count(*) AS ai_failed
    FROM public.tech_news_failed
    WHERE error_reason = 'AI Analysis Failed'
      AND created_at >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '15 days'
      AND created_at <  (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 day'
    GROUP BY 1
),
daily AS (
    SELECT ok.day, ok.total, ok.too_long, COALESCE(bad.ai_failed, 0) AS ai_failed
    FROM ok LEFT JOIN bad ON bad.day = ok.day
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS baseline_days,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total) AS median_total,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN total > 0 THEN too_long::numeric / total ELSE 0 END
           ) AS median_too_long_rate,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN (total + ai_failed) > 0
                             THEN ai_failed::numeric / (total + ai_failed) ELSE 0 END
           ) AS median_ai_fail_rate
    FROM daily
),
win AS (
    SELECT (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '24 hours' AS since
),
analysed AS (
    SELECT title_cn, summary, sentiment
    FROM public.tech_news, win
    WHERE created_at > win.since
      AND summary IS NOT NULL
      AND summary <> 'Analysis failed due to content access issues.'
),
failed AS (
    SELECT error_reason FROM public.tech_news_failed, win WHERE created_at > win.since
)
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM analysed) AS analysed_total,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM analysed WHERE NOT (title_cn LIKE '[AI] %' OR title_cn LIKE '[安全] %' OR title_cn LIKE '[硬件] %' OR title_cn LIKE '[开发] %' OR title_cn LIKE '[商业] %' OR title_cn LIKE '[生态] %')) AS tag_invalid,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM analysed WHERE char_length(summary) > 200) AS summary_too_long,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM analysed WHERE summary !~ '[。！？]$') AS summary_no_end_punct,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM analysed WHERE summary ~ '["'']') AS summary_ascii_quote,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM analysed
      WHERE sentiment NOT IN ('Positive','Negative','Neutral')) AS sentiment_invalid,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM failed WHERE error_reason = 'AI Analysis Failed') AS ai_failed,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM failed WHERE error_reason = 'Content Fetch Failed') AS fetch_failed,
    b.baseline_days,
    round(COALESCE(b.median_total, 0)::numeric, 1) AS baseline_median_total,
    round(COALESCE(b.median_too_long_rate, 0)::numeric, 4) AS baseline_too_long_rate,
    round(COALESCE(b.median_ai_fail_rate, 0)::numeric, 4) AS baseline_ai_fail_rate
FROM baseline b;
